text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Whoa! Lookit, that's a full-fledged ryokan! You're tellin' me we get to stay here for our boot camp? Don't mind if I do!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I believe the actual site of the Heartfire
Ceremony is close by as well,
so it'll be the
perfect place to focus on practice.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
...Oguri, I know you're chowin' down in
your head, but you gotta have
some
self-control.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
H-how'd you know I was going for
seconds?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Your eyes were all sparkly! Wait,
whaddaya mean seconds?!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Haha! Business as usual—love to see it!
Now, by the look of this
place, I'd say
we're in for top-notch baths.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Hehe.
I can already tell this will be quite
different to our usual
summer camp—my
heart's already sounding its excitement.

Students of Tracen Academy, you must be
weary from the road—allow
me to extend
to you a warm welcome.

text_block_list.name: Ms. Mukai
text_block_list.text:
I am president of the Heartfire Ceremony
Preservation Society—you may call me
Mukai.
I will be instructing you during your
time here, and I look forward to getting
started.

text_block_list.name: All
text_block_list.text: Nice to meet you!

text_block_list.name: Ms. Mukai
text_block_list.text:
Energetic responses, bright faces—that
motivation is just what I
wanted to see.

text_block_list.name: Ms. Mukai
text_block_list.text:
Now, I know you've just arrived, but once
you drop off your bags in
your rooms, we'll
head to the Ring, where the Heartfire
Ceremony is held.

text_block_list.name: Ms. Mukai
text_block_list.text:
Today,
you'll have a look around the ritual
grounds, and afterwards, I'll brief you on
what you can expect from this training
camp going forward.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, so this is the Ring, eh? Ya got the
sky all around ya... Standin'
here, I feel
like I'm ready for anythin'.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Plus, the air itself feels tranquil,
almost. As
if we're completely cut off
from the
mundane world below.

text_block_list.name: Ms. Mukai
text_block_list.text:
The Heartfire Ceremony has been held in
this sanctuary since time immemorial. The
sensations you describe may be due to
lingering
echoes of past rituals.

text_block_list.name: Ms. Mukai
text_block_list.text:
Okay, now that you've had a look, I will
explain how you'll be
spending your time
here at camp, so please listen carefully.

text_block_list.name: Ms. Mukai
text_block_list.text:
Beginning today,
you will be practicing the
two rituals which make up the Heartfire
Ceremony: the Rite of Entwinement, and
the Rite of Procession.

text_block_list.name: Ms. Mukai
text_block_list.text:
The goal is for each of you to be capable
of carrying out all parts of
the ceremony
from start to finish.

text_block_list.name: Ms. Mukai
text_block_list.text:
There will be rehearsals mid-camp and on
the last day. I'll be using
them to evaluate
your progress, so please practice with
those milestones in mind.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
We all gotta be able to do every part of
the ceremony, huh? Sounds
like a lot to
learn. This won't be easy.

text_block_list.name: Ms. Mukai
text_block_list.text:
After the final rehearsal, if I judge your
progress to be satisfactory, you will then
decide amongst yourselves who will
perform which role
in the ceremony.

text_block_list.name: Ms. Mukai
text_block_list.text:
That was only an overview, but I won't
belabor you with specifics for
now. Are
there any questions about what was just
discussed?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Yes.

text_block_list.name: Ms. Mukai
text_block_list.text: Yaeno Muteki, was it? Please.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...I doubt it will happen,
but supposing we
do not sufficiently master
the rituals by
the final rehearsal, what will happen?

text_block_list.name: Ms. Mukai
text_block_list.text:
If it comes time for the final rehearsal
and your performance has yet to attain a
certain standard,
there will be no Heartfire Ceremony this
year.

text_block_list.name: Ms. Mukai
text_block_list.text:
Let that be a reminder as to just how
important this ceremony is. I can
only hope
that you will take your duties just as
seriously.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
...Talk about responsibility.
But that's what
makes it worth doin'!
Right, guys? Let's do
this!

text_block_list.name: Ms. Mukai
text_block_list.text:
It seems I have nothing to worry about.
Your training will begin in
earnest
tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Ms. Mukai
text_block_list.text:
For the sake of all Umamusume who
choose to run, I ask that you work
hard to
become the best Heartfire Bearers you can
be.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The following morning marks the start of
their long days of practice.

text_block_list.name: Ms. Mukai
text_block_list.text:
Today, we begin work on the first of the
two rites, the Entwinement.
You'll be
practicing the initial portion.

text_block_list.name: Ms. Mukai
text_block_list.text:
The Entwinement begins at an altar
constructed at the foot of the mountain,
where sole slates inscribed with the
wishes of retired
runners are fed into a bonfire.

text_block_list.name: Ms. Mukai
text_block_list.text:
You will face the altar's flame and
perform
a dance expressing
feelings of awe—that is
the first job of a Heartfire Bearer.

text_block_list.name: Ms. Mukai
text_block_list.text:
Before anything else, you must learn the
proper posture and breathing technique,
then we will go through the choreography
one
move at a time.

text_block_list.name: Ms. Mukai
text_block_list.text:
That's enough! You are still rushing,
all of you. Focus on creating a
contrast between
stillness and motion. Same part, one more
time.

text_block_list.name: All
text_block_list.text: Yes, ma'am!

text_block_list.name: Ms. Mukai
text_block_list.text:
You two,
your steps are still too fast. Feel
the spacing and the rhythm
with your
body. Once more, from the top.

text_block_list.name: All
text_block_list.text: Yes, ma'am!

text_block_list.name: Ms. Mukai
text_block_list.text:
Well, that concludes this morning's group
practice. Good work.

text_block_list.name: Ms. Mukai
text_block_list.text:
We'll have another group practice tonight.
Until then, get some rest,
and be sure to
review what you were told this morning.
Dismissed.

text_block_list.name: All
text_block_list.text: Thank you!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
GAAAH! I knew it'd be rough, but that was
somethin' else! A full-on
physical AND
mental workout—training never gets me
this tired!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
This is what it takes to perform the duty
entrusted to us... A true test!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Heh, if this is how things're startin'
out, I
can't wait to see what's
comin'. This is
shapin' up to be one helluva boot camp!
